pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Tree View (single select) with flat treeitems carrying aria-level, aria-setsize, and aria-posinset, kept in DOM reading order, with one roving tab stop. Connectors are decorative SVG. Moves in edit mode use cut/paste keys and toolbar buttons (no deprecated ARIA drag-and-drop attributes) with live-region announcements.

aria.value: Depth (1-based), number of siblings, position among siblings
true for the selected node, false otherwise
0 on the focused (roving) node, -1 on the others
true at the zoom limits, and for Move / Move here / Undo / Redo when not possible
true while a node is cut for moving
Polite: zoom level, path, moved, undone, redone, move cancelled. Assertive: ready to move, not allowed, locked, load failed.

keyboard.action: Moves through the toolbar buttons, then to the tree (one tab stop: the focused node).
Next / previous visible node in tree order (reading order); the view pans to keep it visible.
Collapsed: expands (loading reports first); expanded: moves to the first report.
Expanded: collapses; otherwise moves to the manager.
Selects the node (aria-selected) and emits aui-node-select.
Expands all siblings of the node.
Typeahead: moves to the next visible node whose name starts with the typed text (0 is reserved for fit).
Zoom in / out around the viewport center; announces 'Zoom {percent}'.
Fit the chart into the view.
Marks the node for moving; announces '{label} ready to move. Go to the new manager and press Control V, or Escape to cancel.' Locked nodes announce '{label} cannot be moved.'

keyboard.context: Edit mode, a node is marked
keyboard.action: Makes the marked node a report of the focused node (last position); announces '{label} now reports to {parent}.' or why it is not allowed; focus follows the moved node.

keyboard.context: Edit mode, a node is marked

focus: One node is in the Tab order (roving tabindex): the last focused node, else the first top-level node. Collapsing a manager of the focused node moves focus to that manager. Re-rendering (expand, move, update) keeps focus on the same node; after a paste focus moves to the moved node. reveal() focuses the node by default. The focused card shows a focus-ring outline; focusing a node pans the view so it is fully visible.
notes: Moving people never requires dragging (2.5.7): Ctrl/Cmd+X and Ctrl/Cmd+V from the keyboard, or select a node, press Move, select the new manager, press Move here with a single pointer.
Tree order in the DOM matches the visual order (managers before their reports, siblings in order), so reading order equals focus order (1.3.2, 2.4.3).
Selected and highlighted nodes differ by border weight and fill, not by color alone (1.4.1).
The report count chip is decorative; aria-expanded conveys expandability.
Zoom and pan are available from the keyboard and toolbar; focus movement pans automatically, so keyboard users never need to pan.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
Screen readers in browse mode may intercept arrow keys and letters; users need focus mode inside the tree.
Ctrl/Cmd+X, V, Z, and Y are taken in edit mode while a node has focus (no text editing happens inside the tree).
Pointer drags (pan, move) are not announced.
